_about: English queries with the canon_refs that answer them. `bible-rag eval retrieval` searches each corpus of the case's testament (OT: web, oshb_wlc, lxx_swete; NT: web, sblgnt) and records the rank of the first expected verse. `kind`: quote = close to the WEB wording, paraphrase = different wording. Cases with no `expected` are off-topic and only record the signals, for calibrating confidence.
